Package org.apache.juneau.rest.client

Class PolicyEnforcedRedirects

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.client.PolicyEnforcedRedirects
public final class PolicyEnforcedRedirects extends Object
Shared Juneau-controlled redirect loop for SSRF-guard-active (TransportRequest.isSsrfGuardActive()) @Remote requests.

Every first-party transport that supports the SSRF guardrail's connect-time contract (see HttpTransport.supportsUrlPolicy()) disables its own automatic redirect-following for policy-covered requests and instead routes each hop through execute(TransportRequest, HopExecutor), which re-runs the RemoteUrlPolicy pre-check — and, via the supplied PolicyEnforcedRedirects.HopExecutor, pin-on-connect — on every Location hop. A public @Url that redirects to http://169.254.169.254/ or http://127.0.0.1/ is rejected exactly as a direct request to that target would be.

Follows conventional 3xx semantics: 301/302/303 rewrite the method to GET with no body, unless the original method was already GET/HEAD; 307/308 preserve the original method and body. A non-repeatable body cannot be safely re-sent, so such a redirect is refused (fail closed) rather than risking a corrupt or partial replay. The chain is capped at RemoteUrlPolicy.MAX_REDIRECT_HOPS hops.

Caller-set credential headers (RedirectSecurity.stripOnCrossOrigin(), matched case-insensitively) are carried to a hop only when it is the same origin as the first request in the chain and not an https → http downgrade (see RedirectSecurity.shouldStripCredentials(URI, URI)); otherwise they are dropped for that hop. A hop that returns to the first origin gets them back, but only when its method is GET or HEAD (a 307/308 replay of a POST after leaving the first origin stays stripped).

  • Method Details

    • execute

      public static TransportResponse execute(TransportRequest initial, PolicyEnforcedRedirects.HopExecutor executor) throws TransportException
      Runs the redirect loop for a policy-covered @Remote request.
      Parameters:
      initial - The initial request. TransportRequest.isSsrfGuardActive() is expected to be true.
      executor - Performs one pinned hop; see PolicyEnforcedRedirects.HopExecutor.
      Returns:
      The final (non-redirect) response.
      Throws:
      TransportException - If a hop fails, the redirect chain exceeds RemoteUrlPolicy.MAX_REDIRECT_HOPS, a hop targets a denied host, a Location is invalid or its origin cannot be compared, or a non-repeatable body would need to be replayed.
